City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
May 21, 2012
07:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of city plaque to outgoing Public Safety and Traffic Commissioner Joe McGrath.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Special City Council and Adjourned City Council Meetings held May 2, 2012 and Regular City Council Meeting held May 7, 2012. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
2012-05-02 CC Minutes - Special meeting
2012-05-07 CC Minutes
2012-05-02 Minutes
c.
Approval of Demands
2012-05-21 CC Staff Report #5.C.
d.
Report submitting a Resolution accepting a grant of easement for street and highway purposes located at the southwest corner of Murad Avenue and 262nd Street. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
2012-05-21 CC Staff Report #5.D.
e.
Report submitting approval of a Professional Services Contract with Kobata Associates Inc. for preparation of a Request for Proposal (RFP) for the Gymnasium and Community Building upgrade project in the amount not-to-exceed $3,840.00. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
2012-05-21 CC Staff Report #5.E.
f.
Report recommending adoption of Resolution appointing Michael Rock City Manager/City Clerk effective June 25, 2012; Approve Employment Agreement and authorize the Mayor to execute agreement on behalf of the City. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
PUBLIC HEARING
2012-05-21 CC Staff Report #5.F
6.
LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE DISTRICT
Public Hearing on proposed assessment for the annual maintenance, operation and servicing of the parkway landscaping along the north side of Palos Verdes Drive North and resolution approving the engineer?s report and confirming the assessment for 2012/13. Presented by Public Works Director Damasse.
2012-05-21 CC Staff Report #6
SCHEDULED MATTERS
7.
COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS
Report recommending that appointments be made for one (1) term expiration on the Planning Commission and five (5) vacancies on the Railroad Museum Foundation Board. Presented by Interim City Manager Sugano.
2012-05-21 CC Staff Report #7
8.
CYPRESS WATER PRODUCTION FACILITY - BLENDING
Discussion and possible direction to staff regarding blending water from Well No. 5 with West Basin-MWD water. Presented by Public Works Director Damasse.
2012-05-21 CC Staff Report #8
8.
CYPRESS WATER PRODUCTION FACILITY - BLENDING
Discussion and possible direction to staff regarding blending water from Well No. 5 with West Basin-MWD water. Presented by Public Works Director Damasse.
9.
SCHEDULE MEETING DATES
Selection of meeting dates to hold a budget workshop and public hearing for the FY 12-13 City Budget. Presented by Interim City Manager Sugano.
2012-05-21 CC Staff Report #9
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
